_comment: Entity names that a routed page asks the adapter for with no route behind it. Every entry carries the measured reason it cannot be served yet. The guard test fails if a new unserved name appears, and also fails if a name here becomes served, so this list can only shrink deliberately.
measured: 23 Nov 2026, release 5e559ca: 102 routed page modules, 96 entity names at 382 call sites, 44 unserved at 74 call sites

unserved.AttackFinding: no offensive finding store; red-team results land in security_findings
unserved.AttackSimulation: no simulation store; authorized_targets exists but no simulation records
unserved.AuthorizationPolicy: no authorisation-policy store; the simulator has no policy input
unserved.AutoRemediationPolicy: no per-asset-type policy store; the remediation engine acts only when asked
unserved.BoardReport: no board-report store; reports are exported, not saved
unserved.ComplianceEvidenceAudit: no compliance evidence audit store; evidence and audit_events are separate
unserved.ComplianceGap: no gap store; gaps are derived from failing controls
unserved.ComplianceRecommendation: no recommendation store; recommendations come from the reasoning engine, not a table
unserved.ContainmentAction: no containment store and no execution path; actions are proposals in the answer
unserved.CopilotAuditLog: no copilot audit store; audit_events covers governed actions only
unserved.CopilotReport: no report store; the chat exports Markdown client-side and says so
unserved.CopilotSession: no copilot session store; missions and cost_records are the record
unserved.CopilotTask: no copilot task store; missions and mission_tasks are the real records
unserved.DataSource: no data-fabric stores at all (sources, catalog, lake, quality rules)
unserved.EvidenceActivity: the evidence table exists but carries no per-record activity feed; needs a route over audit_events joined to evidence
unserved.EvidenceLibrary: the evidence table exists; the library page needs a listing route over it rather than a new store
unserved.ExecutiveInsight: no insight store; insights are generated per answer
unserved.FleetScalingConfig: no autoscaling store and no scaler; the platform runs fixed supervisor processes
unserved.FleetScalingRun: no autoscaling store and no scaler
unserved.IdentityThreat: no identity-threat store; identity signals live in security_findings and ciem_findings
unserved.IncidentComment: no comment store; incident_comms writes are refused rather than silently dropped
unserved.IncidentTimeline: no incident_timeline table exists; the timeline is derived from incident_tasks and audit_events, which need a join route
unserved.LicenseRisk: no licence store; SBOM ingestion never ran, so there is nothing to licence-scan
unserved.MSSPClientOrganization: /mssp/customers serves this shape already; the page must be repointed
unserved.NationalThreat: no national threat store; nothing ingests national advisories
unserved.NotificationDispatch: no dispatch log; /notifications is per-user, not a delivery record
unserved.Organization: no organisation store beyond tenants; multi-org grouping is not modelled
unserved.OrganizationRiskProfile: no per-organisation risk profile store; risk is tenant-level
unserved.PentestCampaign: no campaign store; pentest_agreements and authorized_targets exist but no campaigns
unserved.PostureAlertConfig: no posture-alert configuration store; drift_alert_configs covers drift only
unserved.RegulatoryNotification: the regulatory_notifications table exists; needs a listing route over it
unserved.RiskScoringConfig: no scoring-config store; risk weights are code, not data
unserved.SBOM: no SBOM store; no generator has run, so a listing would be empty
unserved.SelfHealingEvent: no self-healing store and no healer; nothing repairs automatically
unserved.SlaTarget: no SLA target store; sla policy lives in org_settings columns
unserved.SlackAlertSetting: no alert-channel settings store; alert_rules holds rules, not channel configuration
unserved.Team: no team store; users and roles carry no team grouping
